Key points from the caption:
1. Joint investigation (합동 감식) has begun to determine the cause of the explosion at Hanwha Aerospace that resulted in 7 casualties (5 dead, 2 injured)
2. Police, fire department, and National Forensic Service are involved
3. They will check the ignition point and flammable materials, then send evidence for detailed analysis
4. Families of victims participated in the investigation
5. Autopsy (부검) is being conducted today to identify the deceased through DNA analysis (bodies not yet identified due to explosion impact)
